Name: Challenging Community Center Bundles
Author: Jaksha6472
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/7sP0RGq.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=3][color=#dd643a]This is the CHALLENGING VERSION of this mod. If you're looking for vanilla style bundles, you can find them here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21340]Custom Community Center Bundles[/url][/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/br9RloX.png[/img][/center]

[center][color=#c9b490][size=3]This overhaul attempts to create a challenging but not frustrating experience fulfilling the community center bundles while also providing more variety to these.[/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#c9b490][size=3]Included are special rewards for fulfilling the bundles and even bundle variants for the remixed bundle versions! 'Challenging' is interpreted as needing crops/fruits/artisan products only available after year 2 or later, utilizing more artisan machines, the necessity for buying and saving products for cooking recipes or trying your luck in the mines.[/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#c9b490][size=3]Maybe you should save some of these precious artifacts you discover around town, too~[/size][/color][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4HgJ9np.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#dd643a]Please check the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/440]FAQ[/url] for more information.[/color][/size][/center]

[list][color=#c9b490][size=3][*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]If you're using the [b]"Vanilla Cornucopia"[/b], [b]"Cornucopia RSV"[/b], [b]"Cornucopia SVE"[/b] or [b]"Cornucopia RSV SVE"[/b] bundle variant:
[list]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops (Only Essential Pack needed)[/url]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers (Only Essential Pack needed)[/url]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisian Machines[/url]
[*]Download and install all necessary dependencies of these mods
[/list]
[*]If you're using the [b]"Vanilla RSV"[/b], [b]"Cornucopia RSV"[/b], [b]"RSV SVE"[/b] or [b]"Cornucopia RSV SVE"[/b] bundle variant:
[list]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]
[*]Download and install all necessary dependencies of this mod
[/list]
[*]If you're using the [b]"Vanilla SVE"[/b], [b]"Cornucopia SVE"[/b], [b]"RSV SVE"[/b] or [b]"Cornucopia RSV SVE"[/b] bundle variant:
[list]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[*]Download and install all necessary dependencies of this mod
[/list]
[*]Download the latest version of <YourChosenBundleVariant> in the download section and unzip it, then copy
[list]
[*][code]Challenging Community Center Bundles[/code]
[/list]into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
[*]You're done; run the game using SMAPI! Enjoy!
[/size][/color][/list]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/lz3OBZw.png[/img][/center]


[color=#c9b490][size=3]Under some circumstances your savegame might be affected by the changes of this bundle mod. To revert the changes follow the following guideline:

[list]
[*]Set the ChallengingCommuntyCenter config to [code]"Pure_Vanilla"[/code]
[*]The config can be found in the ChallengingCommuntyCenter folder
[*]Load your affected savegames and play at least one day till the game saved the changes
[*]This will reset all bundle entries in the savegame to the pure vanilla counterparts
[*]After that please delete all reminders of this mod
[/list][/size][/color]


[center][size=3][color=#c9b490]This mod will always be open source, you can check the source code on [url=https://github.com/Jaksha6472/ChallengingCommunityCenterBundles]GitHub[/url].[/color][/size][/center]
